digest.component_or_area: code-review gate dispatch and criteria routing
propositions: Project code-review criteria store applies_to but never validate or read it at dispatch time, causing criteria to execute regardless of changed files
applies_to field is silently ignored in project criteria dispatch because _activated_code_review_project_criteria filters only on criterion_id and exec type, ignoring file globs
_validate_routing_entry does not validate applies_to shape or content, allowing malformed values to persist silently instead of failing loudly
Code-review gate lacks the project-criteria file-gating logic present in plan-review orchestrator and registry
Project criteria dispatch path bypasses the workflow's membership gating by appending after req.criteria, circumventing when expressions that would apply file-based filters
